kategorie.aesthetik.beschreibung.text: Treatments that are about how your teeth look: colour, shape, position and how they work together with your face.

kategorie.angst.beschreibung.text: For everyone who keeps putting off the dentist: treatment under sedation, with nitrous oxide or under general anaesthetic.

kategorie.chirurgie.beschreibung.text: Surgical procedures in the mouth: wisdom teeth, extractions, bone grafting – with experience and a gentle technique.

kategorie.funktion.beschreibung.text: When jaw, muscles and teeth no longer work together: grinding, TMJ disorders, jaw joint pain and tension.

kategorie.implantologie.beschreibung.text: Artificial tooth roots as a firm foundation for a single tooth, a bridge or a complete jaw.

kategorie.kieferorthopaedie.beschreibung.text: Correcting misaligned teeth – with almost invisible aligners or classic braces, for children and adults.

kategorie.kinder.beschreibung.text: Dentistry that does not frighten children – from the very first check-up to treating chalky teeth.

kategorie.vorsorge.beschreibung.text: Everything that keeps larger treatments from becoming necessary in the first place – from professional cleaning to early detection.

kategorie.zahnerhalt.beschreibung.text: Saving your own tooth instead of replacing it – root canal treatment, gum disease therapy and gentle fillings.

kategorie.zahnersatz.beschreibung.text: When tooth structure is missing: fillings, inlays, crowns, bridges and dentures – made in our own master laboratory.

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.faq.0.antw.text: We recommend two to four appointments a year, depending on how well oral hygiene works at home and whether you have had gum disease in the past.

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.faq.0.frag.text: How often should an implant be checked?

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.faq.1.antw.text: An inflammation of the tissue around the implant which, untreated, breaks down bone and in the worst case costs you the implant. It does not hurt at first – which is why regular checks matter so much.

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.kasse.text: A private service. Where an implant already exists, supplementary insurance often contributes.

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.kurz.text: Specialised aftercare for implants – so they last a lifetime.

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.patientenf.text: How do I care for my dental implants properly?

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.teaser.text: Implants cannot decay, but they can lose the bone they stand in if the surrounding tissue becomes inflamed. Implant maintenance checks exactly that and cleans the implant surfaces with instruments made for the purpose.

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.ab.text: We look at your teeth and gums and stain the plaque so it becomes visible – you can see for yourself where the problem areas are.
Soft and hard deposits are loosened with a powder jet and ultrasound – no scraping with sharp instruments.
The tooth surfaces are smoothed and protected with fluoride. Smooth surfaces give bacteria less to cling to.
You get concrete tips on brushes, technique and aids – based on what we actually found.

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.fa.text: In the vast majority of cases, no. We work with a powder jet rather than sharp hand instruments. If your gums are inflamed or your tooth necks are sensitive, tell us – we will numb those areas locally.

Twice a year for most adults. If you are prone to gum inflammation, smoke, wear braces or have implants, three to four appointments a year are better. We agree the rhythm together, based on your findings.
How often is a professional clean worthwhile?
Your teeth return to their natural colour, because external staining from coffee, tea or red wine disappears. It will not make them lighter than your natural shade – that requires whitening.
Will it make my teeth whiter?

Wait about an hour after the fluoride treatment. After that we recommend avoiding strongly colouring food and drink such as red wine, coffee or curry for around 24 hours – freshly polished surfaces take on colour more readily at first.
Can I eat and drink straight afterwards?

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.ka.text: Statutory health insurance usually does not cover professional cleaning. Many funds do contribute through bonus schemes – ask yours beforehand.

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.ko.text: 150 to 250 € per hour of treatment, depending on the work involved

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.ku.text: A thorough clean where your toothbrush and floss cannot reach.

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.pa.text: How often should I have my teeth professionally cleaned?

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.te.text: During a professional clean we remove plaque and staining from the places you cannot reach at home. This prevents decay and gum inflammation, and leaves your teeth noticeably smoother and brighter.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.0.antwort.text: The powder jet also reaches the spaces between teeth and the gum pockets, where hand instruments struggle. At the same time it removes less tooth substance. To you it feels like a warm jet of water rather than scraping.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.0.frage.text: Why is the powder jet better than classic scraping?

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.1.antwort.text: Especially then. The erythritol powder we use is very fine and is applied with water at body temperature. Many people with sensitive tooth necks find this method considerably more comfortable than a classic clean.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.1.frage.text: Is it suitable for sensitive teeth?

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.2.antwort.text: Yes. The method was developed explicitly for implant surfaces and restorations as well, and does not attack ceramic or titanium. Do tell us what work you have in your mouth – we adjust the powder and pressure accordingly.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.2.frage.text: Does it work with implants, crowns and veneers?

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.kasse.text: A private service, not included in the statutory catalogue. Private insurers usually reimburse the treatment in full.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.kurz.text: Cleaning to the GBT protocol – no scraping, just a warm powder jet.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.patientenfrage.text: What is the difference between Prophylaxis 4.0 and an ordinary clean?

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.teaser.text: Prophylaxis 4.0 is our cleaning concept following the GBT protocol. Instead of scraping with sharp hand instruments, we loosen deposits with a warm, fine powder jet. It is more thorough, gentler on enamel and gums – and for most people considerably more pleasant.

leistung.veneers.ablauf.0.text.text: We photograph and scan your teeth and talk about what bothers you. On screen you see a preview of the possible result.

leistung.veneers.ablauf.1.text.text: Depending on the starting point, very little or no enamel is removed. You get temporary shells so you can test shape and length in everyday life.

leistung.veneers.ablauf.2.text.text: The finished veneers are tried in, checked for colour and fit, and then bonded permanently.

leistung.veneers.faq.0.antwort.text: Considerably less than it used to be. With classic veneers about half a millimetre of enamel is removed. In suitable cases we work with non-prep veneers and no grinding at all. What is possible for you depends on tooth position and starting shape – we clarify that before the first cut.

leistung.veneers.faq.0.frage.text: Does a lot of healthy tooth have to be ground away?

leistung.veneers.faq.1.antwort.text: With good care and regular checks, ceramic veneers usually last ten to fifteen years, often longer. The greatest risk to them is grinding your teeth at night – so we check for that beforehand and fit you with a splint if needed.

leistung.veneers.faq.2.antwort.text: Not if they are carefully planned. Ceramic transmits light much like natural enamel. What matters is that shape, length and colour suit your face – which is why we work with a preview and temporaries before anything becomes final.

leistung.veneers.faq.2.frage.text: Can people tell they are veneers?

leistung.veneers.faq.3.antwort.text: If enamel has been removed, the restoration is permanent – the tooth will always need a facing. Non-prep veneers, by contrast, can in principle be taken off again. We tell you clearly beforehand which route applies to you.

leistung.veneers.kasse.text: Purely cosmetic veneers are a private service and receive no contribution from statutory insurance. Where there is a demonstrable medical indication – after an accident, for instance – part of the cost may be reimbursed.

leistung.veneers.kosten.text: 900 to 1,800 € per tooth, depending on material and effort

leistung.veneers.kurz.text: Wafer-thin ceramic shells that change the shape and colour of the visible teeth.

leistung.veneers.patientenfrage.text: What do veneers cost and how long do they last?

leistung.veneers.teaser.text: Veneers are thin ceramic shells bonded to the front of your anterior teeth. They correct discolouration, small gaps, chipped edges and slight misalignment – usually within two to three appointments.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.faq.0.antwort.text: For the bonus booklet, one appointment per calendar year is enough for adults. Medically we recommend two – decay and gum inflammation often develop within a few months and do not hurt for a long time.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.faq.1.antwort.text: Not routinely. We only take X-rays if there is a specific suspicion or the last images are old – typically every two years. Every image is explained and justified to you beforehand.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.faq.2.antwort.text: No. We do not judge, we examine. A great many people come to us after a long break, and we go through what makes sense now, calmly and in an order that works for you.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.faq.2.frage.text: I have not been to a dentist for years. Will I be told off?

leistung.zahnvorsorge.kasse.text: Statutory health insurance covers two check-ups per year in full. Both appointments belong in your bonus booklet.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.kosten.text: No charge for patients with statutory insurance

leistung.zahnvorsorge.kurz.text: The six-monthly check – short, painless and the best protection against expensive treatment.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.patientenfrage.text: What happens at a dental check-up?

leistung.zahnvorsorge.teaser.text: At a check-up we systematically examine your teeth, gums and oral tissues. Early decay and gum inflammation can be treated while the effort is still small – and the entry in your bonus booklet secures you higher insurance contributions towards dentures.

ui.start.warumTitel.text: Why this website is organised by location

ui.start.warumZwei.text: That is why every treatment page here belongs to exactly one location – with its address, phone number, opening hours and booking.
